breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the incorrect instruction to use a single uniform internal torque over the full length and explicitly requires dividing the shaft into two segments (0–750 mm and 750–1500 mm) and determining internal torque in each segment. This matches the ground-truth piecewise treatment.
